name: Mukesh
bio:
Mukesh  is an Indian film & stage actor and politician known for his work in Malayalam cinema. 

He's best known for his comic-oriented roles. Mukesh is the current Member of the Legislative Assembly (M.L.A.) representing the Kollam constituency of Kerala state.
